scenarios.name: Stage commands for part and assembly targets from a part document

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
ribbon customization is open with "All Commands" selected
the Part | Tools and Assembly | Design custom targets are empty
the user adds "2D Sketches" to the Part | Tools target without applying
the Part | Tools target is marked as changed
the user selects the Assembly | Design target
the assembly target list is empty
"2D Sketches" is available in the source list
the user adds "2D Sketches" to the Assembly | Design target
"2D Sketches" appears in the assembly target list
the Assembly | Design target is marked as changed
the user returns to the Part | Tools target
"2D Sketches" remains in the part target list
the Part | Tools target remains marked as changed
the user cancels customization
the customization dialog closes
the part document remains active
the user reopens customization from the Tools ribbon
the Part | Tools target is empty
"2D Sketches" is available in the source list
the user selects the Assembly | Design target
the assembly target is empty
"2D Sketches" is available in the source list
the user closes customization
the part document remains active
